entries.name: CNSS employer contributions (family 6,5 %, pensions 5 %, occupational risks 1,5 %)
entries.statute: Décret n° 18/041 du 24 novembre 2018 fixant les taux de cotisations dues à la CNSS art. 2-4, 8, 10 (droitcongolais.info file 830.11.18.8, R4/fetch/cd11); assiette déplafonnée (Ordonnance 92-087 du 20 août 1992; arrêté du 1er mars 2013) [text version: Décret n° 18/041 du 24 novembre 2018 as published (droitcongolais.info file 830.11.18.8, R4/fetch/cd11); no later rate decree located (flag)]
entries.doc: art. 2: prestations aux familles '6,5 %, à charge exclusive de l'employeur'; art. 3: pensions 10 %: '5 % à charge de l'employeur; 5 % à charge du travailleur'; art. 4: risques professionnels '1,5 % à charge exclusive de l'employeur'; art. 8: base not below the SMIG; art. 10: transitional rates only to 1 January 2019.
unsupported: INPP training contribution (rate by headcount, instrument not read)

entries.name: Contribution patronale à l'ONEM (0,5 %)
entries.statute: Arrêté ministériel n° 028/CAB/MIN/ETPS/MBL/DKL/dag/2013 du 18 mars 2013 art. 1er (droitcongolais.info file 820.03.13) [text version: arrêté of 18 March 2013 as published (droitcongolais.info file 820.03.13, R4/fetch/cd11); no later arrêté located (flag)]
entries.doc: art. 1er: 'Le taux de contribution due à l'Office National de l'Emploi, ONEM en sigle, par chaque employeur, tant public, parapublic que privé, est fixé à 0,5 % de la rémunération mensuelle payée par l'employeur à ses travailleurs.'
unsupported: no later order found (the registry note's 0,2 % is not supported by a text held)

entries.name: Impôt mobilier on dividends (20 %)
entries.statute: Code des impôts (consolidation 2023) Livre I, IIème partie, art. 26 (impôt mobilier); finance laws 2024-2025 not read (flag)
entries.doc: art. 26: 'L'impôt mobilier est fixé à 20 %', on income of movable capital (dividends, interest and other income of securities and claims).

entries.name: Impôt mobilier on interest (20 %)
entries.doc: art. 26: 'L'impôt mobilier est fixé à 20 %' (also on interest on claims, deposits and bonds within its scope).
unsupported: exemptions of savings-bank and certain deposit interest not checked

entries.name: INPP contribution (employer, vocational training: 3 % / 2 % / 1 % of pay by headcount)
entries.statute: Ordonnance-loi 206 of 29 June 1964 and Decree 09/55 of 3 December 2009 (INPP); interministerial rate order after 1984 not read; rates by headcount from PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Congo, Democratic Republic of the, Individual - Other taxes, social security section: last reviewed 15 October 2024 (Wayback capture 2025-11-14, R4/fetch/swp/pwc_cd_indother_wb20251114.txt) and the same rates on the page last reviewed 21 April 2026 (R4/fetch/swp/pwc_cd_indother_live20261121.txt)
entries.doc: Secondary-source sweep (2026-11-22): the guide gives an employer-only INPP contribution of 3 % for private employers with at most 50 employees and for State-owned companies, 2 % for 51-300 employees and 1 % above 300; the same three rates appear in the PwC review of 15 October 2024 (captured November 2025) and of 21 April 2026, so they held through 2025. Kernel 2.6.0 employer facts: the employer's headcount ('employerEmployees' of an adult, 'employees' of a company); headcount unknown -> no charge, grade C (never guessed). Worked cases (hand): wages 1 000 000 at an employer of 40 -> 30 000; of 120 -> 20 000; of 400 -> 10 000; no headcount -> nothing, listed; company payroll 10 000 000 with 40 employees -> 300 000, with 301 -> 100 000.
unsupported: employer headcount not given: no charge, grade C
State-owned companies with more than 50 employees (3 % in the guide) are not told apart: the headcount rule is applied
the interministerial rate order itself not read (B, guide)

entries.name: Impôt sur les véhicules (vignette) and taxe spéciale de circulation routière (provincial)
entries.statute: Code des impôts (DGI, mis à jour au 10 juillet 2023), world/B08-central-africa-fr/cd/law/CODE-DES-IMPOTS-2023.txt: impôt sur les véhicules (Ordonnance-loi 69-006) art. 40-45, rate article 41 with the editorial note on Constitution art. 204 point 16 and Loi n° 11/011 (finances publiques) art. 9 al. 5; taxe spéciale de circulation routière (Ordonnance-loi 88-029) art. 4, same note
entries.why: No national rate: both taxes are provincial and local taxes (Constitution art. 204 point 16) whose rates are fixed by each province (LFP art. 9 al. 5); the Code's rate tables (art. 41; TSCR art. 4) are printed blank. A provincial edict (e.g. Kinshasa) for 2025 is not held, so no province's tariff is modelled
entries.tried: local copy of the Code des impôts 2023 (art. 36-45 and the TSCR ordinance read); no provincial edict located this pass
